parameters.responseBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  success: true,
  intake_id: $json.id,
  risk_tier: $json.classification.risk_tier,
  risk_score: $json.classification.risk_score,
  approval_decision: $json.approval_decision,
  assigned_approver: $json.assigned_approver || 'Auto-Approved',
  estimated_review_days: $json.classification.estimated_review_days,
  next_action: $json.next_action,
  message: $json.message,
  required_controls: $json.classification.required_controls,
  primary_risk_factors: $json.classification.primary_risk_factors
}, null, 2) }}
